services.name: Historic Walking Tours
services.desc: Discover the rich history of Port Alberni with a self-guided historic walking tour. These tours, presented by the Alberni Valley Museum, contain historic information and photographs to help you engage with the built heritage of three different areas of the City of Port Alberni. Enjoyable for locals and tourists alike, they are available online or in a PDF format which can be downloaded and viewed on your portable device. Paper versions are available at the Alberni Valley Museum (4255 Wallace

blurb: Located in the heart of Port Alberni, the Alberni Valley Museum, reflects the richly diverse past of the area, with a large collection of artefacts linked to First Nations culture, local and industrial history, and folk art. The Alberni Valley Museum uses a unique Visible Storage system to make the entire collection available to the visitor at all times - along with the information, in easy to use catalogue books.
